description:
Where klunking meets Minnesota.

The fattest sb2 that ever was. 4.6"tubeless rubber on a velocity dually is the perfect tire profile for ripping....fast. a super comfy and super cabpable desert and or snow runner that's way more effecient than you'd expect. I would, and am seriously tempted to throw bags on and ride down baja on this thing.

Large/xl size...see the sb2 chart. a s/m is possibile.

Doomonē chromoly risers with a fillet brazed stem.

hub is a 215mm KT hub..rebuilt and special greased with the upgrade nuts and cool cool cooler. front is a super limited skunkworks 135mm carbon nukeproof..non disk.

this thing is actually light and fast...i cant stress that enough. Supple no brake front fork .. A better riding mone may not exist.
